final: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS artifact_count FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref), overall AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.artifact_count, 1.0 * s.artifact_count / o.artifact_total AS share FROM site_totals AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.artifact_total IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.zoneref, s.artifact_count, s.share, s.share - m.average_share AS difference_from_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.average_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_average IS NULL, difference_from_average DESC, s.zoneref LIMIT 10
